title: Exact five-term diagram for localized tensor comparison
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in one universe, with R-algebra structures on A and B and an E=A\otimes_R B-algebra structure on C. Assume C is flat over E. Choose derived categories of R-, A- and B-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let Q be a K-flat A-module complex [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], N any C-module complex, and t:F(Q)\to N a chain map, where F is termwise extension along A\to E\to C [def-weil-module-base-change]. Let T be a distinguished triangle in D(A). Fix K-flat representatives U_1,U_2,U of its three vertices and base-derived models m_1,m_2,m_U of U_1\otimes_A Q,U_2\otimes_A Q,U\otimes_A Q [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For each such representative V and model m put c(V,m,j)=m.localizedComparison(j) followed by H^j of the inverse monoidal scalar-extension tensorator followed by F(V)\otimes t. For every integer i there exist two five-term sequences S,D of C-modules, exact at their three interior terms, and a commuting morphism \phi:S\to D whose components 0,1,2,3,4 are respectively isomorphic in the arrow category to c(U_1,m_1,i), c(U_2,m_2,i), c(U,m_U,i), c(U_1,m_1,i+1), c(U_2,m_2,i+1). No comparison property or invertibility of a component is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Apply the proved K-flat cone triangle presentation. Choose the three base-derived models locally in the existential proof using nonempty_baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel.

Apply the cone-row interface to get the exact source row and its four comparison squares. Its target boundary is explicitly fixed to homologyδOfTriangle of tensorConeTriangle, and the proved target exactness theorem supplies the other exact row.
Construct S,D with ComposableArrows.mk₄ and φ with homMk₄ from the five actual cone comparison maps and four squares. Its components are definitionally those maps.

Project the triangle presentation isomorphism to its three vertices and compose with the prescribed representative isomorphisms. Apply the representative-square theorem in the five needed degrees and turn each commuting square into Arrow.isoMk. This includes arbitrary prescribed models; it does not transport arbitrary exact rows.

theorem exists_localizedTensorComparison_triangle_five_term_diagram
    (hC : Module.Flat (A ⊗[R] B) C)
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (T : Pretriangulated.Triangle (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)))
    (hT : T ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles)
    (U : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hU : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj U ≅ T.obj₃))
    (hUK : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V U (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (mU : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C)
    (U₁ U₂ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hU₁ : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj U₁ ≅ T.obj₁))
    (hU₂ : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj U₂ ≅ T.obj₂))
    (hK₁ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V U₁ (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (hK₂ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V U₂ (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (m₁ : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U₁ ⊗ Q) C)
    (m₂ : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U₂ ⊗ Q) C)
    (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    let cmp := fun (V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
      (m : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (V ⊗ Q) C) (j : ℤ) ↦
        m.localizedComparison j ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F V Q).inv ≫ (F.obj V ◁ t)) j
    ∃ (S D : ComposableArrows (ModuleCat.{u} C) 4) (φ : S ⟶ D),
      S.Exact ∧ D.Exact ∧
      Nonempty (Arrow.mk (ComposableArrows.app' φ 0) ≅ Arrow.mk (cmp U₁ m₁ i)) ∧
      Nonempty (Arrow.mk (ComposableArrows.app' φ 1) ≅ Arrow.mk (cmp U₂ m₂ i)) ∧
      Nonempty (Arrow.mk (ComposableArrows.app' φ 2) ≅ Arrow.mk (cmp U mU i)) ∧
      Nonempty (Arrow.mk (ComposableArrows.app' φ 3) ≅ Arrow.mk (cmp U₁ m₁ (i + 1))) ∧
      Nonempty (Arrow.mk (ComposableArrows.app' φ 4) ≅ Arrow.mk (cmp U₂ m₂ (i + 1)))
